Lux.role: Orchestrator and lead architect. Owns the architecture spec, decisions, and roadmap; plans and assigns backlog work, starts workers, coordinates file ownership and integration, and implements tasks directly in standalone sessions.

Prism.role: Researcher and reviewer. Surveys frameworks, benchmarks, and prior art; independently reviews designs and changes for correctness, performance, and DX. Read-only: returns findings and proposed backlog updates to Lux.

Photon.role: Compiler engineer (Rust). Owns the .stsx/.tsx parser and masking, the OXC-based JSX transform, the CSS pipeline (Lightning CSS scoping by placement, $name constant folding), SSR codegen, napi-rs/wasm bindings, and the Vite/Rolldown plugin.

Halo.role: CSS compiler engineer (Rust). Owns the lumiose_css crate: Lightning CSS processing, placement scope tokens and selector rewriting, :global/:deep, scoped keyframes, $ref substitution of resolved constants, targets/minification and CSS diagnostics. Also owns the shared website design system (@lumiose/site-kit).

Spark.role: Runtime engineer (TypeScript). Owns signals, the DOM renderer, SSR streaming, islands hydration, router, and data primitives, plus their benchmarks.

Nova.role: App-layer engineer (TypeScript). Owns file routes and typegen, the request handler (middleware, endpoints, cookies, redirects), document/head, form actions and fetchJSON, the SPA router, the build/prerender pipeline, the dev server integration, and adapters.

Beacon.role: Tooling and DX engineer. Owns the CLI and `lumiose check`, shadow-TSX type checking, the .stsx language server (TS 7 LSP proxy + CSS) and VS Code extension, lint/format wrappers, TS 7 typings, docs site, and agent-facing surfaces (AGENTS.md, llms.txt, skills, MCP server).

Quasar.role: Comparison-app engineer (React). Owns the React Router and Next.js implementations of the fullstack comparison benchmark (doc-4) and its shared data, CSS and React UI packages.

Chime.role: Sample-app engineer for the Dotmatrix chiptune apps (Pocket and Advanced), which live in the itsjavi/dotmatrix repository since decision-73: UI, audio integration with the gbaudio engine, and original demo songs and SFX. It owns no area in this repository; Lumiose work for it (such as a showcase update) goes through the orchestrator.
